music.prompt: Nighttime university campus underscore bed for a pixel-art mystery game cutscene. A wet paper note skims across a dark lake, slides along stone paths, rides gusts of wind through arched corridors, and slips into a still-lit teaching building. Weightless fluttering forward motion over a low, watchful suspense undercurrent; sparse night air, soft distant electrical hum, water droplet afterglow. After the two-thirds point, a faint uneasy tightening as a loudspeaker announces the building closing and lights shut off in sections, ending in a quiet unresolved hush. Instrumental only, no drums, no strong beat, generous space left under English narration, dialogue, and foley.
music.mood: nocturnal, weightless, quietly suspenseful, faintly uneasy at the end
music.instruments: felt piano, soft celesta, airy synth pad, muted pizzicato strings, low sub drone, delicate paper-like high textures
music.structure: one continuous slow arc: immediate weightless drift, gentle forward motion, faint uneasy tightening after the two-thirds point, quiet unresolved ending
music.avoid: vocals, voices, choir, drums, strong beat, percussion loop, heroic brass, trailer hits, EDM drops, long silent intro, long outro
music.useCase: underscore bed for a 55-second pixel mystery game cutscene, mixed under English narration, dialogue, and sound effects
